initial_presentation: On an automated packaging line the pneumatic pusher does not extend. The HMI shows that a cycle request is present. No active alarms are displayed. It worked earlier today.

evidence_available_on_request.observation: Auto_Enabled = TRUE and Safety_OK = TRUE in HMI read-only diagnostics.
Cycle_Request = TRUE, Pusher_Extend_CMD = FALSE, Pusher_Retracted = TRUE.
The part is visibly present in the expected location.
After documented isolation and verification by an authorized technician, the part-present sensor bracket is found displaced.

reference_for_evaluator_only.synthetic_root_cause: Displaced part-present sensor bracket caused Part_Present = FALSE; PLC therefore inhibited Pusher_Extend_CMD.
reference_for_evaluator_only.diagnostic_conclusion: Distinguish cycle request from actuator command, then discriminate PLC permissive from electrical/pneumatic causes before considering repair.
reference_for_evaluator_only.safety_note: Only site-approved procedures and qualified staff can authorize physical inspection, isolation and restoration.
